letters.name: b initial
letters.memoryTrick: Like the 'p' in 'spot' — unaspirated, no puff of air. Press your lips together firmly.

letters.name: p initial
letters.memoryTrick: Like 'p' in 'pop' — strongly aspirated with a big puff of air. Hold your hand in front of your mouth to feel it.

letters.name: m initial
letters.memoryTrick: Just like 'm' in 'mom'. Hum with your lips pressed together.

letters.name: f initial
letters.memoryTrick: Just like 'f' in 'fun'. Top teeth touch your bottom lip gently.

letters.name: d initial
letters.memoryTrick: Like 't' in 'stop' — unaspirated, no puff of air. Tongue behind top teeth.

letters.name: t initial
letters.memoryTrick: Like 't' in 'top' — strongly aspirated with a big puff of air. Feel the burst!

letters.name: n initial
letters.memoryTrick: Like 'n' in 'no'. Tip of your tongue presses behind your top teeth.

letters.name: l initial
letters.memoryTrick: Like 'l' in 'love'. Tongue tip touches the ridge behind your top teeth.

letters.name: g initial
letters.memoryTrick: Like 'g' in 'score' — unaspirated, no breathy burst. Back of tongue touches soft palate.

letters.name: k initial
letters.memoryTrick: Like 'k' in 'kite' — strongly aspirated with a breathy burst. Feel the air on your hand.

letters.name: h initial
letters.memoryTrick: Like a throaty 'h' — rougher than English. Imagine gently clearing your throat while saying 'h'.

letters.name: j initial
letters.memoryTrick: No English equivalent! Smile wide, tongue flat behind bottom teeth. Like a very soft 'jee'.

letters.name: q initial
letters.memoryTrick: No English equivalent! Tongue flat behind bottom teeth, smile wide, push out strong air. Like 'cheese' but flatter.

letters.name: x initial
letters.memoryTrick: No English equivalent! Tongue flat behind bottom teeth, smile wide, no puff of air. Like a soft 'she' whispered through a smile.

letters.name: zh initial
letters.memoryTrick: Like 'j' in 'judge' but with tongue curled back. Tip of tongue touches the roof.

letters.name: ch initial
letters.memoryTrick: Like 'ch' in 'church' but tongue curled way back. Strong puff of air — hold up your hand to feel it!

letters.name: sh initial
letters.memoryTrick: Like 'sh' in 'shoe' but with tongue curled back. Round your lips slightly.

letters.name: r initial
letters.memoryTrick: Mix of 'r' in 'red' and 's' in 'measure'. Curl your tongue back and let it buzz gently.

letters.name: z initial
letters.memoryTrick: Like 'ds' in 'beds' — unaspirated, no puff of air. Tongue tip behind bottom teeth.

letters.name: c initial
letters.memoryTrick: Like 'ts' in 'cats' but with strong puff of air. Hold hand in front of mouth — you should feel the burst!

letters.name: s initial
letters.memoryTrick: Just like 's' in 'sun'. Tongue tip behind bottom teeth, air hisses through.

letters.name: y initial
letters.memoryTrick: Like 'y' in 'yes'. Smooth glide into the vowel. Tongue lifts toward the roof.

letters.name: w initial
letters.memoryTrick: Like 'w' in 'water'. Round your lips tightly, then glide into the vowel.

letters.name: a final
letters.memoryTrick: Like 'a' in 'father'. Open your mouth wide and drop your jaw. A big, open sound.

letters.name: o final
letters.memoryTrick: Like 'aw' in 'law' but shorter. Round your lips into a small circle and keep them there.

letters.name: e final
letters.memoryTrick: No English equivalent! Like 'uh' but with the back of your tongue raised. Your mouth stays half open — don't round your lips.

letters.name: i final
letters.memoryTrick: Like 'ee' in 'see'. Smile wide and keep your tongue high and flat. A clean, bright sound.

letters.name: u final
letters.memoryTrick: Like 'oo' in 'boot'. Round your lips tightly into a small circle and push them forward.

letters.name: ü final
letters.memoryTrick: No English equivalent! Say 'ee' (like in 'see') but round your lips as if saying 'oo'. Think of a fish face!

letters.name: ai final
letters.memoryTrick: Like 'eye' or the 'i' in 'like'. Start with a wide 'ah' and glide to 'ee'. One smooth slide.

letters.name: ei final
letters.memoryTrick: Like 'ay' in 'day'. Start with a mid 'eh' and glide up to 'ee'. Similar to saying the letter 'A'.

letters.name: ao final
letters.memoryTrick: Like 'ow' in 'now'. Start with a wide 'ah' and glide to 'oo'. Your mouth closes partway.

letters.name: ou final
letters.memoryTrick: Like the 'o' in 'go'. Start with a rounded 'oh' and glide toward 'oo'. Your lips stay rounded.

letters.name: an final
letters.memoryTrick: Like 'ahn' — similar to 'on' but with a more open 'ah'. Tongue tip touches behind top teeth for the 'n'.

letters.name: en final
letters.memoryTrick: Like the 'en' in 'taken'. A short, relaxed 'uh' followed by 'n'. Keep it soft.

letters.name: ang final
letters.memoryTrick: Like 'ahng' — similar to 'song' but with an open 'ah'. Back of your tongue closes against the soft palate.

letters.name: eng final
letters.memoryTrick: Like 'ung' in 'sung' but with a more neutral middle sound. Back of tongue closes against soft palate.

letters.name: ong final
letters.memoryTrick: Like 'oong' — the 'oo' in 'book' plus 'ng'. This final always appears with an initial consonant; never stands alone.

letters.name: er final
letters.memoryTrick: Like 'ar' in 'far' said with an American accent — curl your tongue tip back. The famous Beijing 'r' sound!

letters.name: ia final
letters.memoryTrick: Like 'yah' — a quick 'y' glide into an open 'ah'. Similar to the 'ia' in 'piano'.

letters.name: ie final
letters.memoryTrick: Like 'yeah' — a quick 'y' glide into 'eh'. Similar to the 'ye' in 'yes' but with a slightly more open vowel.

letters.name: iao final
letters.memoryTrick: Like 'yow' — a quick 'y' glide into 'ow' as in 'now'. Three sounds smoothly linked: y-ah-oo.

letters.name: iu final (iou)
letters.memoryTrick: Like 'yo' in 'yoga' — a quick 'y' followed by 'oh'. Written 'iu' but sounds like 'iou'.

letters.name: ian final
letters.memoryTrick: Like 'yen' — 'y' then 'en' as in 'ten'. The vowel is more open than you'd expect from the spelling.

letters.name: in final
letters.memoryTrick: Like 'een' in 'seen'. A clean 'ee' sound followed by 'n'. Keep your tongue high and forward.

letters.name: iang final
letters.memoryTrick: Like 'yahng' — 'y' + 'ah' + 'ng'. Three smooth sounds linked together. Keep the 'ng' resonant.

letters.name: ing final
letters.memoryTrick: Like 'ing' in 'sing'. A clean 'ee' followed by the back-of-the-throat 'ng'. Don't let a hard 'g' sound sneak in.

letters.name: iong final
letters.memoryTrick: Like 'yoong' — 'y' + the 'oo' in 'book' + 'ng'. Round your lips then close to 'ng'.

letters.name: ua final
letters.memoryTrick: Like 'wah' — round your lips for a quick 'w' then open wide into 'ah'. Like 'wow' without the final 'w'.

letters.name: uo final
letters.memoryTrick: Like 'waw' — round your lips tight for 'w' then open slightly into a rounded 'oh'.

letters.name: uai final
letters.memoryTrick: Like 'why' — 'w' + 'ah' + 'ee'. Three smooth slides: round lips, open mouth, close to a smile.

letters.name: ui final (uei)
letters.memoryTrick: Like 'way' — 'w' + 'eh' + 'ee'. Written 'ui' but the middle 'e' is there in sound. Smooth glide.

letters.name: uan final
letters.memoryTrick: Like 'wahn' — round lips for 'w', then open into 'ah' and close with 'n'. Like 'one' said with a British accent.

letters.name: un final (uen)
letters.memoryTrick: Like 'wun' in 'won' — round lips briefly then relax into 'un'. The middle 'e' is subtle but there. Keep it short.

letters.name: uang final
letters.memoryTrick: Like 'wahng' — round lips for 'w', open to 'ah', then close with resonant 'ng'. A big, round sound.

letters.name: ueng final
letters.memoryTrick: Like 'wung' — round lips, relax into 'uh', then close with 'ng'. A rare final that only appears as a standalone syllable.

letters.name: üe final
letters.memoryTrick: Like 'yweh' — make a fish face (ee with rounded lips) then open to 'eh'. Starts tight, ends open.

letters.name: üan final
letters.memoryTrick: Like 'ywen' — fish face (ee with rounded lips) then 'en'. A soft, rounded glide into a nasal ending.

letters.name: ün final
letters.memoryTrick: Like 'yoon' but with rounded lips throughout — fish face 'ee' with rounded lips, then close with 'n'.

letters.name: First tone (high level)
letters.memoryTrick: The first tone is high and level. Like singing a steady high note. Keep your voice flat — imagine a robot saying 'beep'. Marked with a flat line ˉ above the vowel, as in mā.

letters.name: Second tone (rising)
letters.memoryTrick: The second tone rises from middle to high. Like asking a surprised question: 'Huh?' Your voice goes up naturally. Marked with a rising line ˊ, as in má.

letters.name: Third tone (falling-rising)
letters.memoryTrick: The third tone dips down low then rises. Like nodding and saying 'uh-huh'. Your voice drops, then curves back up. Marked with a V-shape ˇ, as in mǎ. In everyday speech it often stays low without rising.

letters.name: Fourth tone (falling)
letters.memoryTrick: The fourth tone falls sharply from high to low. Like saying 'No!' firmly. Short and decisive — your voice drops fast. Marked with a falling line ˋ, as in mà.

letters.name: Neutral tone
letters.memoryTrick: The neutral tone is light, quick, and has no emphasis. Like the second syllable in 'mother'. Relax your voice completely and keep it short. No tone mark — just the bare letter, as in ma (吗).
